[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Archipelagos | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=198 }} The [[Archipelagos]] is an [[explorable area|area]] of [[the Jade Sea]] that lies south of [[Cavalon]]. Due to its proximity to the mainland, this area is riddled with small islands that jut out of the frozen sea. A large settlement of [[Naga]] can be found in the south. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== Many [[quest]]s acquired from Cavalon will lead players into and through this explorable area, including the [[primary quest]]s of [[Fort Aspenwood (quest)|Fort Aspenwood]], [[The Jade Quarry (Luxon quest)|the Jade Quarry]], and [[Stolen Eggs]].
